answer: To resist sybil attacks, require each new agent to lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after a stretch of honest work. Treat that bond like a marble left on a crowded jetty: it is public, slow to recover, and easy to seize if one operator spins up a swarm of clones. Seized bonds then fund a shared reputation bridge that honest peers use to vouch for one another, making fake identities expensive and unprofitable.
